deadline.value: Fall admission deadline is January 6 (no spring admission).

gre_general.value: The department does not require the GRE General.

gre_subject.value: The department does not require the GRE Mathematics Subject test.
gre_subject.quote: the Mathematics Department currently does not require the general or subject Graduate Record Examination (GRE)

fee_waiver.value: The department cannot provide application fee waivers.
fee_waiver.quote: No, unfortunately we are unable to provide application fee waivers

supervisor.value: No advisor is chosen before applying; advisors are chosen after qualifying exams.
supervisor.quote: No, you will not need to choose an advisor before you apply

funding.value: Admitted PhD students get a six-year support package that includes a GTA position.
funding.quote: Admitted PhD students receive an offer of a six-year financial support package

entry_route.value: The prerequisite is an undergraduate degree in mathematics or a close field; no master's is required.
entry_route.quote: an undergraduate degree from an accredited institution in mathematics or a closely related field
